title: Ziyarat of Hazrat Hamza
intro: The visitation of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib at Uhud, with the source edition’s associated supplication.
description: Read Ziyarat of Hazrat Hamza with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
Visiting the tomb of Hamzah ibn ‘Abd al-Muttalib, at Uhud

the Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have given high importance to visit the tomb of his uncle Hamzah. Lady Fatima (sa) also visited his grave often

Al-Islam Wikishia for more on the Master of Martyrs Martyrdom Date 7 or 15 Shawaal

There are 2 sites in the compound .One with 3 graves one after the other and the next one of Other Martyrs.

The 3 graves are of Hz. Hamzah ibn `Abd al-Muttalib,

Abdullah Bin Jahash ( cousin of the prophet)

Mosab bin Omair.( sent by the Prophet(saws) to Medina before his own Hijrat )

Ziarat of Hz Humza the chief of martyrs,

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَمَّ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O uncle of Allah’s Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household.
Peace be upon you, O best of martyrs.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اسَدَ ٱللَّهِ وَاسَدَ رَسُولِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya asada allahi wa asada rasulihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Lion of Allah and of His Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta fi allahi `azza wa jalla
blocks.english: I bear witness that you strove in the way of Allah—the All-mighty and All-majestic—,
sacrificed yourself,
acted sincerely towards Allah’s Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household,

blocks.arabic: وَكُنْتَ فِي مَا عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَانَهُ رَاغِباً
blocks.transliteration: wa kunta fi ma `inda allahi subhanahu raghiban
blocks.english: and desired sincerely for that which is possessed by Allah, the Glorified.
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!

blocks.arabic: اتَيْتُكَ مُتَقَرِّباً إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِزِيَارَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ataytuka mutaqarriban ila allahi `azza wa jalla biziyaratika
blocks.english: I have come to you seeking nearness to Allah, the All-mighty and All-majestic, through visiting your tomb,
and seeking nearness to Allah’s Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household, through visiting your tomb, too.
I thus carry the desire that you may intercede for me.
Through my visiting you, I also desire for redemption of myself,

blocks.arabic: مُتَعَوِّذاً بِكَ مِنْ نَّارٍ ٱسْتَحَقَّهَا مِثْلي
blocks.transliteration: muta`awwidhan bika min narin istahaqqaha mithli
blocks.english: seeking your protection against the Fire that is deserved by my matches
for what I have done against myself,
fleeing from my sins
that I have gathered on my shoulders,
and turning to you for security, in the hope of gaining the mercy of my Lord.
I have come to you from a far distance,
seeking for release of my neck (i.e. self) from Hellfire
although I have overburdened my back with my sins
and I have committed that which enrages my Lord.

blocks.transliteration: wa lam ajid ahadan afza`u ilayhi
blocks.english: I cannot find anyone to whom I may resort

blocks.arabic: خَيْراً لِي مِنْكُمْ اهْلَ بَيْتِ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ
blocks.transliteration: khayran li minkum ahla bayti alrrahmati
blocks.english: better than you, the Household of Mercy;

blocks.arabic: فَكُنْ لِي شَفِيعاً يَوْمَ فَقْرِي وَحَاجَتِي
blocks.transliteration: fakun li shafi`an yawma faqri wa hajati
blocks.english: so, (please) intercede for me on the day of my poverty and neediness,
for I have walked to you aggrieved,
I have come to you distressed,
I have shed tears in your presence,
and I am now alone before you.

blocks.transliteration: wa anta mimman amaraniya allahu bisilatihi
blocks.english: You are of those with whom Allah has ordered me to build unbreakable ties,
He has urged me to obey,
He has shown me your merits,
He has guided me to the love for you,
He has encouraged me to get to you,
and He has inspired me to seek the settlement of my needs at your tombs.

blocks.arabic: انْتُمْ اهْلُ بَيْتٍ لاََ يَشْقَىٰ مَنْ تَوَلاَّكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: antum ahlu baytin la yashqa man tawallakum
blocks.english: As for you the Ahl al-Bayt (the Household of the Prophet), whoever pays homage to you shall never encounter unhappiness,
whoever comes to you shall never be disappointed,
and whoever loves you shall never fail,
but whoever provokes the hostility of you shall never be pleased.

blocks.text: You may then turn your face towards the kiblah direction and offer a two unit prayer. After accomplishment, you may throw yourself on the tomb and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, I expose myself to Your mercy
as I attach myself to the tomb of Your Prophet’s uncle,
peace be upon Your Prophet and his Household

blocks.transliteration: liyujirani min niqmatika wa sakhatika wa maqtika
blocks.english: so that he (i.e. Your Prophet’s uncle) may rescue me from Your chastisement, Your wrath, and Your ire
on the day when cries will be great in number,

blocks.transliteration: wa tushghalu kullu nafsin bima qaddamat
blocks.english: when each soul will be engaged with what it has sent before,
and each soul will plead for itself.

blocks.arabic: فَإِنْ تَرْحَمْنِي ٱلْيَوْمَ فَلاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيَّ وَلاَ حُزْنٌ
blocks.transliteration: fa'in tarhamni alyawma fala khawfun `alayya wa la huznun
blocks.english: If You have mercy upon me on that day, then neither fear nor grief shall come upon me.

blocks.arabic: وَإِنْ تُعَاقِبْ فَمَوْلَىًٰ لَهُ ٱلْقُدْرَةُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa in tu`aqib famawlan lahu alqudratu `ala `abdihi
blocks.english: But if You punish me, then You are the Master Who has full power over His slave.
Please, do not disappoint me any more after this day
and do not cause me to leave without having my requests granted.
I have attached myself to the tomb of Your Prophet’s uncle

blocks.transliteration: wa taqarrabtu bihi ilayka ibtigha'a mardatika
blocks.english: and I have sought nearness to You through him in the hope of gaining Your pleasure
and in the desire of winning Your mercy.
So, (please) accept from me
and confer upon my unreason with Your forbearance
and upon my mistreatment against myself with Your kindness.
My offenses are too great;
yet, I do not anticipate that You may wrong me,
but I anticipate terrible reckoning.

blocks.arabic: فَٱنْظُرِ ٱلْيَوْمَ تَقَلُّبِي عَلَىٰ قَبْرِ عَمِّ نَبِيِّكَ
blocks.english: So, (please) on this day, notice my turning on the tomb of Your Prophet’s uncle;
and, in the names of both of them (i.e. the Holy Prophet and his uncle), release me from Hellfire,
do not frustrate my efforts,
do not belittle my invocation to You,
do not cause my voice not to reach You,
and do not make me leave (this place) without having my needs settled for me.

blocks.transliteration: ya ghiyatha kulli makrubin wa mahzunin
blocks.english: O Succor of all aggrieved and saddened ones!
O Reliever of the grieved, confused,
drowned, and perishable ones!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: وَٱنْظُرْ إِلَيَّ نَظْرَةً لاََ اشْقَىٰ بَعْدَهَا ابَداً
blocks.transliteration: wanzur ilayya nazratan la ashqa ba`daha abadan
blocks.english: send to me a look (from You) that saves me from unhappiness forever,
and have mercy upon my obtestation, tears, and loneliness.
I do hope for Your pleasure

blocks.arabic: وَتَحَرَّيْتُ ٱلْخَيْرَ ٱلَّذِي لاََ يُعْطيهِ احَدٌ سِوَاكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa taharraytu alkhayra alladhi la yu`tihi ahadun siwaka
blocks.english: and I seek for the good that none save You can provide;
so please do not disappoint me.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تُعَاقِبْ فَمَوْلىٰ لَهُ ٱلْقُدْرَةُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma in tu`aqib famawlan lahu alqudratu `ala `abdihi
blocks.english: O Allah, if You punish me, then You are the Master Who has full power over His slave
and it is naught but my misdeeds that pulled me to Your punishment,
but I beg You not to disappoint me this day,
not to make me leave without having my needs settled for me,

blocks.transliteration: wa la tukhayyibanna shukhusi wa wifadati
blocks.english: and not to disparage my presence and coming,
because I have spent all my disbursement,
caused fatigue to my body,
crossed deserts,

blocks.transliteration: wa khallaftu al-ahla walmala wa ma khawwaltani
blocks.english: left my family, properties, and whatever You have put under my disposal,
preferred that which You have to myself,
and here I am seeking refuge in the tomb of Your Prophet’s uncle,
may peace be upon Your Prophet and his Household,
and sought his nearness—all that has been in the hope of gaining Your pleasure.
So, (please) confer upon my unreason with Your forbearance
and upon my sins with Your kindness,
for my offense is grave.
(Please do that for me) in the name of Your mercy, O All-generous! O All-generous!

blocks.text:
You may then repeat reciting Surah al-Qadr as many times as possible.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت حمزہ علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
